blurb: Set in the natural beauty of Nova Scotia’s South Shore, Castle Lake Campground offers the perfect mix of peaceful lakeside relaxation and coastal exploration. Our 4.4-kilometre lake is ideal for swimming, kayaking, fishing, or simply enjoying breathtaking sunsets and star-filled skies. Just 10 minutes from Little River Beach and 25 minutes from Port Maitland Beach, you can enjoy both lake and ocean during your stay.
